text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding language, recognizing images, or making decisions. To achieve this, computers use machine learning, which means they learn from large amounts of data instead of following fixed instructions. A more advanced form, called deep learning, uses complex layers of artificial neural networks to handle very complicated problems, like translating speech in real time. Today, AI is all around us: it powers voice assistants on our phones, recommends movies on streaming platforms, filters spam from our emails, and even helps doctors diagnose diseases. While AI is still improving, it has already become a quiet but essential part of our daily routines.
